tools.name: envshield_scan
tools.description: Scan .env files, JSON configs, shell logs, or transcripts for leaked API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, Google, Stripe, Telegram, Slack), 64-hex EVM private keys, seed mnemonics, JWTs, database URI passwords, and high-entropy secrets. Returns structured findings and safely redacted text.

tools.name: calldata_decode
tools.description: Decode Ethereum / Base / BSC / Arbitrum 0x hex calldata (ERC-20, Permit2, EIP-2612, ERC-721/1155, Uniswap V2/V3/Universal Router, Safe multisig, AccessControl) and flag unlimited MaxUint256 / MaxUint160 approval risks.

tools.name: tokencost_estimate
tools.description: Estimate per-run, daily, and monthly LLM API and multi-turn AI agent costs across Claude 4.5 (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku), GPT-5/Mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash, and DeepSeek V3 with prompt caching and client retainer markup.

tools.name: cryptobill_quote
tools.description: Generate a clean Markdown/JSON freelance crypto invoice with subtotal/discount/tax math plus a live serverless CryptoBill Forge #inv= shareable A4 PDF & QR payment link.

tools.name: evm_token_risk_scan
tools.description: Audit live EVM token/contract bytecode, EIP-1967 / ZeppelinOS / Beacon / EIP-1167 proxies, SELFDESTRUCT/DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE opcodes, ownership status, and mint/blacklist/pause/tax selectors across Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum.

tools.name: solana_mint_risk_scan
tools.description: Audit live Solana Mainnet SPL Token and Token-2022 mints for active mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, permanentDelegate, transferFeeConfig, transferHook, mintCloseAuthority, and Top-10 holder concentration.

tools.name: brand_domain_handle_scan
tools.description: Check candidate brand or product names live across authoritative RDAP + DoH domains (.com, .io, .ai, .co, .dev, .app, .org, .net), developer/social registries (GitHub, npm, PyPI, Bluesky, Reddit), and the Apple iOS App Store.

tools.name: multi_chain_wallet_scan
tools.description: Inspect 1 to 5 EVM (0x...) and/or Solana (Base58) wallets live across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, BSC, Polygon, and Solana Mainnet for native & stablecoin balances, tx nonces, EIP-7702 delegations, Gnosis Safe M-of-N multisig signers, SPL/Token-2022 holdings, and recent Solana signatures.

tools.name: subtitle_caption_audit
tools.description: Audit and auto-fix SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) subtitles for timestamp overlaps, CPS > 20 reading speed spikes, 9:16 TikTok/Reels/Shorts safe-zone line overflows, and brand keyword casing — returning a 0-100 quality score plus normalized .srt and .vtt.

tools.name: media_brief_audit
tools.description: Audit spoken voiceover scripts (Latin + CJK) and visual production briefs for 135/150/165 WPM duration vs target seconds, FFmpeg atempo distortion risk, celebrity likeness/copyright/trademark pre-flight compliance, and 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 & 4:5 specs.

tools.name: web_clean_extract
tools.description: Fetch any public HTTP/HTTPS web page with strict IPv4/IPv6 SSRF protection and extract clean LLM-ready Markdown, canonical/OpenGraph/JSON-LD metadata, HTML tables converted to CSV + Markdown, and exact estimated LLM token savings versus raw HTML.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "envshield_scan" references sensitive artifacts (private key, .env, password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
